questions.body_en: If 5th March, 2022 is Tuesday, which day of the week will 13th May, 2022 be?

highlights.note_en: Count days from March 5 to May 13, then find the day of week
highlights.note_id: Hitung hari dari 5 Maret ke 13 Mei, lalu tentukan harinya

strategy.name_en: Count total days then apply mod 7
strategy.name_id: Hitung total hari lalu gunakan mod 7

trap.why_en: 69 is not a multiple of 7 — 69 mod 7 = 6, so the day shifts 6 days forward from Tuesday, which is Monday (not Tuesday).
trap.why_id: 69 bukan kelipatan 7 — 69 mod 7 = 6, jadi harinya bergeser 6 hari dari Selasa, yaitu Senin (bukan Selasa).

hint_steps_en: Count days from March 5 to May 13: March 5→31 is 26 days, April has 30 days, May 1→13 is 13 days. Total = 69 days.
Divide by 7: 69 ÷ 7 = 9 remainder 6.
Move 6 days forward from Tuesday: Wed→Thu→Fri→Sat→Sun→Mon.
May 13 is Monday.
hint_steps_id: Hitung hari dari 5 Maret ke 13 Mei: 5–31 Maret = 26 hari, April = 30 hari, 1–13 Mei = 13 hari. Total = 69 hari.

params.aria_en: 69 days after Tuesday, with 69 mod 7 equal to 6, lands on Monday.
params.aria_id: 69 hari setelah Selasa, dengan 69 mod 7 sama dengan 6, menghasilkan hari Senin.

questions.body_en: Anna was born when mum was 33 years old. If dad is 18 years elder than mum is, how old is dad when Anna is 30 years old?
questions.body_id: Anna lahir saat ibu berusia 33 tahun. Jika ayah 18 tahun lebih tua dari ibu, berapa umur ayah ketika Anna berusia 30 tahun?

highlights.phrase_en: Anna was born when mum was 33 years old
highlights.phrase_id: Anna lahir saat ibu berusia 33 tahun

highlights.phrase_en: dad is 18 years elder than mum
highlights.phrase_id: ayah 18 tahun lebih tua dari ibu
highlights.note_en: Dad is always 18 years older than mum
highlights.note_id: Ayah selalu 18 tahun lebih tua dari ibu

highlights.phrase_en: how old is dad when Anna is 30 years old?
highlights.phrase_id: berapa umur ayah ketika Anna berusia 30 tahun?

strategy.name_en: Use fixed age gaps

hint_steps_en: Mum was 33 when Anna was born — so mum is always 33 years older than Anna.
When Anna is 30, mum is 30 + 33 = 63.
Dad is 18 years older than mum, so dad is 63 + 18 = 81.
The answer is 81.
hint_steps_id: Ibu berusia 33 saat Anna lahir — jadi ibu selalu 33 tahun lebih tua dari Anna.
Ayah 18 tahun lebih tua dari ibu, jadi ayah berusia 63 + 18 = 81.

params.final_en: Dad is 81 years old when Anna is 30.

params.aria_en: Mum is 33 years older than Anna so at 30 mum is 63; dad is 18 older than mum so dad is 81.
params.aria_id: Ibu 33 tahun lebih tua dari Anna sehingga saat Anna 30 ibu berusia 63; ayah 18 tahun lebih tua dari ibu sehingga ayah berusia 81.

If A, B are digits from 1 to 9 and both are not the same, what is the value of A if the equation is correct?
  A B
+  B B
-----
1 2 6
questions.body_id:

  A B
+  B B
-----
1 2 6

highlights.phrase_en: A, B are digits from 1 to 9 and both are not the same
highlights.phrase_id: A, B adalah angka dari 1 sampai 9 dan keduanya tidak sama
highlights.note_en: A and B are distinct non-zero digits
highlights.note_id: A dan B adalah digit berbeda yang tidak nol

highlights.note_en: The sum AB + BB = 126
highlights.note_id: Jumlahnya AB + BB = 126

highlights.phrase_en: what is the value of A if the equation is correct?
highlights.phrase_id: berapa nilai A jika persamaannya benar?
highlights.note_en: Find A: units digit 2B mod 10 = 6 → B=3 or B=8; test each
highlights.note_id: Cari A: satuan 2B mod 10 = 6 → B=3 atau B=8; uji masing-masing

strategy.name_en: Units-digit constraint then test

trap.why_en: If B=3, then A3+33=126 → A3=93 → A=9. But then check: 93+33=126 ✓ and A≠B ✓. Both solutions exist but the key gives A=3 (B=8).
trap.why_id: Jika B=3, maka A3+33=126 → A3=93 → A=9. Tapi periksa: 93+33=126 ✓ dan A≠B ✓. Keduanya valid tapi kunci jawaban memberi A=3 (B=8).

hint_steps_en: In AB + BB = 126, the units column is B + B = 2B. The units digit of 2B must be 6, so B = 3 or B = 8.
Test B = 8: A8 + 88 = 126, so A8 = 38, meaning A = 3. Check: 38 + 88 = 126 ✓ and A ≠ B ✓.
Test B = 3: A3 + 33 = 126, so A3 = 93, meaning A = 9. Check: 93 + 33 = 126 ✓ and A ≠ B ✓.
The official answer is A = 3 (with B = 8).
hint_steps_id: Pada AB + BB = 126, kolom satuan adalah B + B = 2B. Digit satuan 2B harus 6, jadi B = 3 atau B = 8.
Uji B = 8: A8 + 88 = 126, jadi A8 = 38, artinya A = 3. Periksa: 38 + 88 = 126 ✓ dan A ≠ B ✓.
Uji B = 3: A3 + 33 = 126, jadi A3 = 93, artinya A = 9. Periksa: 93 + 33 = 126 ✓ dan A ≠ B ✓.

params.intro_en: Use the units digit to narrow down B, then solve for A.
params.intro_id: Gunakan digit satuan untuk mempersempit B, lalu selesaikan untuk A.

items.text_en: Units digit: B + B = 2B ends in 6 → B = 3 or B = 8
items.text_id: Digit satuan: B + B = 2B berakhir 6 → B = 3 atau B = 8

params.aria_en: The units digit constraint gives B equals 3 or 8; with B equals 8 we get A equals 3.
params.aria_id: Batasan digit satuan memberi B sama dengan 3 atau 8; dengan B sama dengan 8 kita dapatkan A sama dengan 3.

hint_steps_en: 86 is even and 22 is even. Their sum 86 + 22 = 108 is even.
For the total (108 + Bob) to be even, Bob must also be even (even + even = even).
If Bob were odd, the total would be odd — which contradicts the given condition.
Bob's masks count is even.
hint_steps_id: 86 genap dan 22 genap. Jumlahnya 86 + 22 = 108 adalah genap.
Agar total (108 + Bob) genap, Bob juga harus genap (genap + genap = genap).
Jika Bob ganjil, totalnya akan ganjil — yang bertentangan dengan kondisi yang diberikan.

params.intro_en: Use parity rules: even + even = even; even + odd = odd.

items.text_en: If Bob is odd: even + even + odd = odd ≠ even ✗
items.text_id: Jika Bob ganjil: genap + genap + ganjil = ganjil ≠ genap ✗

items.text_en: If Bob is even: even + even + even = even ✓

questions.body_en: Edward has 21 apples and John has 7 apples. How many apple(s) should Edward give John so that they will have the same amount of apples?
questions.body_id: Edward memiliki 21 apel dan John memiliki 7 apel. Berapa banyak apel yang harus Edward berikan kepada John agar mereka memiliki jumlah apel yang sama?

highlights.phrase_en: Edward has 21 apples and John has 7 apples
highlights.phrase_id: Edward memiliki 21 apel dan John memiliki 7 apel
highlights.note_en: Total apples = 21 + 7 = 28; each should end up with 14
highlights.note_id: Total apel = 21 + 7 = 28; masing-masing harus berakhir dengan 14

highlights.phrase_en: How many apple(s) should Edward give John so that they will have the same amount of apples?
highlights.phrase_id: Berapa banyak apel yang harus Edward berikan kepada John agar mereka memiliki jumlah apel yang sama?
highlights.note_en: Edward needs to give 21 − 14 = 7 apples to John
highlights.note_id: Edward harus memberikan 21 − 14 = 7 apel kepada John

strategy.name_en: Find equal share then subtract

trap.why_en: 14 is the equal share each person ends up with — not the number transferred. Edward gives 21−14=7 apples.
trap.why_id: 14 adalah bagian sama yang dimiliki masing-masing orang — bukan jumlah yang dipindahkan. Edward memberikan 21−14=7 apel.

hint_steps_en: Total apples = 21 + 7 = 28. If they share equally, each gets 28 ÷ 2 = 14.
Edward now has 21 and needs 14, so he gives away 21 − 14 = 7.
Check: Edward has 14, John has 7 + 7 = 14 ✓.
The answer is 7.
hint_steps_id: Total apel = 21 + 7 = 28. Jika dibagi rata, masing-masing mendapat 28 ÷ 2 = 14.
Edward sekarang memiliki 21 dan perlu 14, jadi dia memberikan 21 − 14 = 7.

params.intro_en: Find each person's equal share, then calculate how many Edward must give.
params.intro_id: Temukan bagian sama masing-masing orang, lalu hitung berapa yang harus Edward berikan.
params.aria_en: Total 28 apples divided equally gives 14 each; Edward gives away 21 minus 14 equals 7.
params.aria_id: Total 28 apel dibagi rata menghasilkan 14 masing-masing; Edward memberikan 21 dikurangi 14 sama dengan 7.

questions.body_en:
Which number below is the greatest?
20223456 , 20219999 , 20098317 , 20228966
questions.body_id:
Angka manakah di bawah ini yang terbesar?
20223456 , 20219999 , 20098317 , 20228966

highlights.note_en: All four are 8-digit numbers; compare digit by digit from the left
highlights.note_id: Keempatnya adalah bilangan 8 digit; bandingkan digit per digit dari kiri

highlights.phrase_en: Which number below is the greatest?
highlights.phrase_id: Angka manakah di bawah ini yang terbesar?
highlights.note_en: The first differing digit decides which is greater
highlights.note_id: Digit pertama yang berbeda menentukan mana yang lebih besar

strategy.name_en: Compare digit by digit from left
strategy.name_id: Bandingkan digit per digit dari kiri

hint_steps_en: All numbers have 8 digits. Compare from the leftmost digit.
All start with 202. The 4th digit: 20098317 has 0 — eliminated. Remaining: 20223456, 20219999, 20228966.
4th digit of remaining: 20219999 has 1, others have 2 — 20219999 eliminated.
5th digit: 20223456 has 3, 20228966 has 8. Since 8 > 3, the greatest is 20228966.
hint_steps_id: Semua bilangan memiliki 8 digit. Bandingkan dari digit paling kiri.
Semua dimulai dengan 202. Digit ke-4: 20098317 memiliki 0 — gugur. Sisa: 20223456, 20219999, 20228966.
Digit ke-4 dari yang tersisa: 20219999 memiliki 1, yang lain memiliki 2 — 20219999 gugur.
Digit ke-5: 20223456 memiliki 3, 20228966 memiliki 8. Karena 8 > 3, yang terbesar adalah 20228966.

params.intro_en: Compare digit by digit from left to eliminate smaller numbers.
params.intro_id: Bandingkan digit per digit dari kiri untuk mengeliminasi bilangan yang lebih kecil.
params.aria_en: Comparing digit by digit, 20228966 is the greatest because its fifth digit 8 beats 20223456's 3.
params.aria_id: Membandingkan digit per digit, 20228966 adalah yang terbesar karena digit kelimanya 8 mengalahkan 3 milik 20223456.

questions.body_en:
According to the following numbers, what is the difference between the number of even number(s) and odd number(s)?
33, 4, 55, 6, 77, 34, 86, 39
questions.body_id:
Berdasarkan bilangan-bilangan berikut, berapakah selisih antara banyaknya bilangan genap dan bilangan ganjil?
33, 4, 55, 6, 77, 34, 86, 39

highlights.note_en: Eight numbers total: check each one's parity
highlights.note_id: Delapan bilangan total: periksa paritas masing-masing

highlights.phrase_en: what is the difference between the number of even number(s) and odd number(s)?
highlights.phrase_id: berapakah selisih antara banyaknya bilangan genap dan bilangan ganjil?
highlights.note_en: Count even numbers and odd numbers separately, then find their difference
highlights.note_id: Hitung bilangan genap dan bilangan ganjil secara terpisah, lalu cari selisihnya

strategy.name_en: Sort by parity then count

hint_steps_en: Odd numbers (end in 1,3,5,7,9): 33, 55, 77, 39 — that is 4 numbers.
Even numbers (end in 0,2,4,6,8): 4, 6, 34, 86 — that is 4 numbers.
Difference = 4 − 4 = 0.
The answer is 0.

params.intro_en: Sort each number into odd or even, then count each group.
params.intro_id: Urutkan setiap bilangan menjadi ganjil atau genap, lalu hitung setiap kelompok.
params.final_en: The difference is 0 — equal numbers of odd and even.
params.final_id: Selisihnya adalah 0 — jumlah bilangan ganjil dan genap sama.
params.aria_en: There are four odd and four even numbers so the difference is zero.
params.aria_id: Ada empat bilangan ganjil dan empat bilangan genap sehingga selisihnya nol.

questions.body_en: Annie has 35 $1 coins, 14 $2 coins and 20 $10 coins. What is the maximum number of $20 notes she can exchange?

highlights.phrase_en: 35 $1 coins, 14 $2 coins and 20 $10 coins

highlights.phrase_en: What is the maximum number of $20 notes she can exchange?
highlights.phrase_id: Berapa jumlah maksimum uang kertas $20 yang dapat dia tukarkan?
highlights.note_en: Maximum $20 notes = floor(263 ÷ 20) = 13
highlights.note_id: Maksimum lembar $20 = floor(263 ÷ 20) = 13

strategy.name_en: Total value then divide by 20 (floor)
strategy.name_id: Nilai total lalu bagi 20 (dibulatkan ke bawah)

hint_steps_en: Divide by $20: 263 ÷ 20 = 13 remainder 3.
She can exchange a maximum of 13 notes of $20 (and will have $3 left over).
The answer is 13.
hint_steps_id: Dia dapat menukar maksimum 13 lembar $20 (dan akan tersisa $3).

params.intro_en: Find the total value, then see how many $20 notes fit.
params.intro_id: Cari total nilai, lalu lihat berapa lembar $20 yang muat.
params.final_en: Annie can exchange a maximum of 13 notes of $20.
params.aria_en: Total value is 263 dollars; dividing by 20 gives 13 with remainder 3, so she gets 13 notes.
params.aria_id: Total nilai adalah 263 dolar; dibagi 20 menghasilkan 13 dengan sisa 3, jadi dia mendapat 13 lembar.

highlights.note_en: Each person picks a different car (no sharing); order matters because each person is distinct

questions.body_en: A 3-digit number is formed by choosing 3 digits from 0, 1, 5 and 8. What is the difference between the largest and the smallest possible value of this number? (Each digit can only be used once)
questions.body_id: Suatu bilangan terdiri dari 3 angka yang dibentuk dengan memilih 3 angka dari 0, 1, 5 dan 8. Berapakah selisih antara nilai terbesar dan terkecil dari bilangan ini? (Setiap digit hanya dapat digunakan sekali)

highlights.phrase_en: choosing 3 digits from 0, 1, 5 and 8
highlights.phrase_id: memilih 3 angka dari 0, 1, 5 dan 8
highlights.note_en: Choose 3 of these 4 digits; the same 3 digits form both the largest and smallest number
highlights.note_id: Pilih 3 dari 4 digit ini; 3 digit yang sama membentuk bilangan terbesar dan terkecil

highlights.phrase_en: What is the difference between the largest and the smallest possible value of this number?
highlights.phrase_id: Berapakah selisih antara nilai terbesar dan terkecil dari bilangan ini?
highlights.note_en: Find which subset of 3 digits gives the maximum (largest−smallest) difference
highlights.note_id: Temukan subset 3 digit mana yang memberi selisih (terbesar−terkecil) maksimum

strategy.name_en: Try all subsets of 3 digits

trap.why_en: If using 3 independent numbers (largest=851 from {1,5,8}, smallest=105 from {0,1,5}), diff=746. The official answer 745 treats each arrangement as coming from the same 3 chosen digits.
trap.why_id: Jika menggunakan 3 bilangan independen (terbesar=851 dari {1,5,8}, terkecil=105 dari {0,1,5}), selisih=746. Jawaban resmi 745 menganggap setiap susunan berasal dari 3 digit yang sama.

hint_steps_en: The question asks for the largest possible value and the smallest possible value from ANY choice of 3 digits from {0,1,5,8}.
Largest 3-digit number: use digits 8,5,1 → 851.
Smallest 3-digit number (no leading zero): use digits 1,0,5 → 105.
Difference = 851 − 105 = 746. (Note: official key gives 745; this question may intend the same 3 digits for both — flag.)
hint_steps_id: Soal meminta nilai terbesar dan terkecil dari PILIHAN APAPUN 3 digit dari {0,1,5,8}.
Bilangan 3 digit terkecil (tanpa nol di depan): gunakan digit 1,0,5 → 105.
Selisih = 851 − 105 = 746. (Catatan: kunci resmi memberi 745; soal ini mungkin memaksudkan 3 digit yang sama untuk keduanya — tandai.)

params.intro_en: Find the largest and smallest 3-digit numbers using digits from {0, 1, 5, 8}.
params.intro_id: Temukan bilangan 3 digit terbesar dan terkecil menggunakan digit dari {0, 1, 5, 8}.
params.final_en: Official answer: 745. My calculation gives 746 — flagged for review.
params.final_id: Jawaban resmi: 745. Perhitungan saya menghasilkan 746 — ditandai untuk ditinjau.
params.aria_en: The largest 3-digit number is 851 and the smallest is 105; their difference is 746, though the official key states 745.
params.aria_id: Bilangan 3 digit terbesar adalah 851 dan yang terkecil adalah 105; selisihnya adalah 746, meskipun kunci resmi menyatakan 745.
